verdict.rationale: Calendly clearly supports creating multiple event types with distinct settings (pre-built event types, an API/MCP tool 'create_event_type', and availability tuning like buffers/custom schedules), but the evidence pack never documents per-event custom questions, and community feedback explicitly notes Calendly refused to add manual/host confirmation before a booking is finalized (comm-9), undercutting the 'confirmation rules' part of the story. missing for 10: explicit docs on custom intake questions per event type, and evidence of configurable confirmation/approval rules (the only related community evidence says this capability was requested and refused).
